integrity: The universal statement is established analytically. Achievability is independently reconstructed by six explicit product Kraus operators with a separable diagonal failure effect; no numerical optimizer is used as proof.
scientific_limitations: Exact one-copy SEP-instrument result for the uniform antisymmetric qutrit state only; it does not determine LOCC, PPT, asymptotic, catalytic, approximate, or nonuniform-source optima. The upper bound requires a separable completion of the failure branch.
title: Exact separable-distillation frontier for the uniform qutrit antisymmetric state
